$comment: DRAIS Product Evolution — Layer 2 of the About module. Human-curated milestones grouping the commit-level changelog (Layer 1) into meaningful product history. Add entries via scripts/update-changelog.mjs --suggest-milestones, then review and edit BY HAND before committing — milestones are never auto-published.

milestones.summary: DRAIS was re-initialized around the DRCE report-card engine — templates, bindings, totals, teacher initials and the marks migration engine.
milestones.significance: Report cards became DRAIS's first product identity: schools could design, compute and print their own documents instead of using fixed layouts.
key_capabilities: DRCE template system (Arabic, Modern Traditional, Minimal Clean, Professional Business)
Configurable subject totals, grand-total rows and averages
Persistent editable teacher initials
Marks Migration Engine with guided wizard
Bulk enrollment with multi-student selection
architectural_changes: DRCE primitives/bindings refactor for full layout control
TiDB schema alignment for report data
Client-side display/hide filtering strategy for large report lists
business_impact: Northgate and Al Bayan produced their first DRAIS-native report cards
Per-school fallbacks (next-term-begins dates) established the multi-tenant pattern
related_commits: 2026-04-27 feat: Implement Marks Migration Engine & Persistent Editable Initials System

milestones.summary: A granular permission catalog with a sync engine, wildcard support and a permission-tree UI; 44+ finance routes and payroll gated behind requirePermission.
milestones.significance: DRAIS stopped trusting roles implicitly. Every sensitive operation became an explicit, auditable permission — the prerequisite for multi-school trust.
key_capabilities: Granular permission catalog + sync engine + wildcards
Permission tree UI with search
Finance reads/writes gated (44 routes)
Payroll hardening: RBAC, wallet debit integrity, soft delete
architectural_changes: requirePermission/userCan as the single authorization primitive
Super-admin lockout protection
Orphaned-permission lint (R5) keeping the catalog honest
business_impact: Schools can delegate finance work without handing over the whole system
related_commits: 2026-05-23 feat(rbac): granular permission catalog + sync engine + wildcards
2026-05-25 feat(rbac): R4 finance writes — gate 24 routes with requirePermission

milestones.summary: Bulk SMS broadcast, scheduled deadline reminders, and the isolated Parent Portal: identity, OTP-verified learner linking, gated read surfaces and a dedicated UI shell.
milestones.significance: Parents became first-class users. DRAIS moved from an internal school tool to a school–home communication platform.
key_capabilities: Bulk SMS — paste numbers or pick an audience
Vercel Cron result-deadline SMS reminders
Parent portal: register, login, link learners with OTP + staff approval
Parent read surfaces: overview, attendance, results, fees
architectural_changes: Portal isolation core — separate identity and access gate from staff auth
School modules admin (per-school feature flags)
business_impact: Schools message every guardian in one action
Parents self-serve results and fees without calling the school
related_commits: 2026-05-27 feat(portal): parent→learner linking with OTP-match + staff approval

milestones.summary: ZKTeco ADMS push ingestion with instant parent SMS, per-school working hours, orphan fingerprint claiming, fuzzy PIN mapping and holiday awareness.
milestones.significance: DRAIS moved from recording attendance to sensing it — punches flow in live from devices, and parents know within seconds.
key_capabilities: ADMS push ingestion (works on Vercel, store-and-forward tolerant)
SMS on punch: parents for learners, headteacher for staff, late-arrival routing
Per-school working/study hours with per-day overrides
Orphan FP claiming + name-aware fuzzy PIN candidates
Holiday CRUD + device alert acknowledgements
architectural_changes: Device → ingest → notify pipeline established
school_hours as the first per-school time policy
business_impact: JIPRA-class schools run gate attendance without manual registers
related_commits: 2026-05-31 feat(adms): SMS notification trigger on ZKTeco ADMS push
2026-06-03 feat(biometric): store FP_CAPTURED_UNMAPPED orphans + admin claim API

milestones.summary: Signature blocks, QR/barcodes as first-class DRCE shapes, public verification URLs bound to each document, and parent-downloadable report PDFs.
milestones.significance: A DRAIS report card became verifiable by anyone with a phone — forged documents die at the QR scan.
key_capabilities: Signed-by signature panels in DRCE
QR + barcode shapes with document binding
Public anti-forgery verify URLs
Parent portal PDF downloads
architectural_changes: Verification tokens as a public, unauthenticated read surface
business_impact: Employers/universities can verify a result slip without contacting the school
related_commits: 2026-06 feat(drce): QR code + barcode as first-class shapes
2026-06 feat(reports): public anti-forgery verify URLs + QR binding

milestones.summary: Electron desktop packaging for Windows, Android APK via Capacitor + nodejs-mobile, and a cross-platform CI release pipeline. Semver baseline (1.0.0) established mid-era.
milestones.significance: DRAIS escaped the browser: schools with unstable internet got a desktop app; the field got an installable APK.
key_capabilities: Windows desktop app (Electron + electron-builder)
Android APK (Capacitor 8 + nodejs-mobile)
Cross-platform desktop CI releases
architectural_changes: Version odometer replaced by semantic versioning (bump-version.mjs)
Standalone bundle handling for native modules
related_commits: 2026-06-03 chore(packaging): Electron + electron-builder scaffold for Windows
2026-06-04 feat(packaging): Android APK scaffold via Capacitor + nodejs-mobile

milestones.summary: Tailwind v4 token migration, dark-mode binding fixed at the root, and a full dark-broken sweep across every component.
milestones.significance: The product started looking like one system instead of many pages — and dark mode became a first-class citizen.
key_capabilities: Theme toggle that actually re-themes every surface
Glass/token design policy
architectural_changes: @custom-variant dark binding; 'no-dark = broken' heuristic with safe automated sweeps
business_impact: Professional appearance in demos and daily use

milestones.summary: Forensic investigation and phased repair of aggregate/division computation: the singular/plural spread bug, the contributing-subjects policy (ICT/IRE/electives never count), and the nursery grade rule.
milestones.significance: Report-card numbers became provably correct — verified against every class, with a verify:divisions gate for future grading changes.
key_capabilities: getContributingAssessmentResults as the single aggregates authority
Division thresholds policy [12,24,28,32]
Nursery most-common-grade rule
architectural_changes: Render-time calculation from snapshotted marks (no stale stored divisions)
business_impact: JIPRA/Al Bayan report cards match manual computation exactly

milestones.summary: The TCP-pull forensic redesign: DeviceWallTime canonical module, staged acquisitions with validation, the device-control wizard with operator time-check, the identity-matching engine (auto/review tiers), and per-weekday arrival rules.
milestones.significance: Attendance stopped depending on the device clock being right or PINs being pre-mapped — time and identity both became verified, correctable layers.
key_capabilities: One-click day pull with names and drift correction
Identity matching with confidence tiers and 1:1 guards
Staff shifts (night workers) beating school rules
Per-weekday arrival overrides (Saturday 10:00)
architectural_changes: punch_at = corrected instant; device_reported_time = verbatim dedup identity
Staged acquisition pipeline (pull → validate → commit)
business_impact: JIPRA's 186-user device fully mapped; nameless logs eliminated
related_commits: v1.80.98 feat(attendance): per-weekday arrival rules + role-labeled dashboard

milestones.summary: From the biometric pass-out foundation and guardian visitation cards to full movement management: identity-verified creation, configurable approvals, AUTHORIZED/NOT-AUTHORIZED gate verdicts, exit-triggered parent SMS and return tracking.
milestones.significance: The school gate became a verified checkpoint: no learner leaves without identity, authorization and a truthful parent notification.
key_capabilities: Verify-first pass creation (fingerprint / student ID / gated manual)
Single or two-step approval workflows
Gate page + live-scan verdicts on gate devices
SMS only after verified exit; optional return SMS
Movement dashboard: outside-now, overdue, frequent leavers
architectural_changes: Gate engine on the live-scan hot path
Pass-out events as a full audit trail with actor + IP
business_impact: Parents are told the truth: SMS reflects actual gate exits, never intentions
related_commits: v1.80.102 feat(passouts): biometric-backed learner movement management

milestones.summary: The Attendance Intelligence Program: self-healing Time Intelligence (drift detection, assisted correction, undo), the ten-check Health Center with an overall score, and the Digital Twin tracing every punch through ten lifecycle stages.
milestones.significance: DRAIS began monitoring, explaining and repairing itself — the founder-independence turn.
key_capabilities: Per-device learned attendance fingerprints + batch confidence scoring
Attendance Health Score with worst-first recommendations
Event Explorer: 'where did it break?' for any punch
Inline clock-health badges where operators actually work
architectural_changes: attendance_time_baselines / device_clock_health / corrections-with-undo
Pure, unit-tested decision engines (assessBatch, composeStages, computeOverallHealth)
business_impact: The +5h JIPRA clock incident class is now caught automatically before reports are trusted

milestones.summary: The About / System Information module: permanent release history generated from git on every commit, and this Product Evolution layer explaining why each era existed.
milestones.significance: DRAIS can now explain its own evolution without depending on founder memory — every future employee can answer 'what is this version and why does it exist?' from inside the product.
key_capabilities: /about: identity, current release, categorized changes, 300+ release history
Self-recording changelog (pre-commit hook, self-healing from git log)
Milestone layer with human-reviewed publishing
architectural_changes: src/data/changelog.json + release-milestones.json as structured, component-free history
business_impact: Product survives beyond its founder: history, reasoning and stability are visible in-app
related_commits: v1.83.0 feat(about): About / System Information module
